notes: 1.0.39: Makes the one-click update far more robust. The app now shuts its own background browser processes down before restarting to swap in the new version (they used to keep the program file locked), the program file is now code-signed so antivirus lets go of it faster, and the updater waits long enough for antivirus to finish scanning before giving up. If the one-click update ever stalls, the installer (IFS-Setup.exe) always applies an update cleanly. Includes the Arduino firmware over-the-internet update from 1.0.38.
